articles.title: North Korean Group UNC1069 Linked to Axios npm Supply Chain Attack
articles.summary: Google has attributed the compromise of the popular Axios npm package to a North Korean financially motivated threat group known as UNC1069. This incident underscores the persistent threat of supply chain attacks originating from nation-state actors targeting widely used software components.

articles.title: China-Linked Red Menshen Uses Stealthy BPFDoor Implants in Telecom Networks for Espionage
articles.summary: A China-nexus threat actor, identified as Red Menshen, is conducting long-term espionage by embedding stealthy BPFDoor implants within critical telecom networks. This sophisticated operation allows for persistent access and spying against government networks, underscoring nation-state cyber threats.

articles.title: China's APT Red Menshen Upgrades BPFdoor Malware for Global Telco Espionage
articles.summary: Chinese APT group Red Menshen has reportedly upgraded its sophisticated BPFdoor malware, designed to spy on telecommunications companies worldwide. This advanced backdoor evades traditional security measures, forcing telcos into a constant hunt for its presence.

articles.title: Critical Cisco IMC Authentication Bypass Vulnerability Disclosed

articles.title: US Bans Foreign-Made Consumer Routers
articles.summary: The US has banned all new foreign-made consumer routers, citing supply chain vulnerabilities and severe cybersecurity risks that could disrupt critical infrastructure and national defense. This policy aims to mitigate potential threats posed by compromised network devices.

articles.title: TrueConf Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks on Government Networks
